steps.title: Create synthetic team project
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The project ID is unused and the member can create a team project.

expectations.description: HTTP 201 returns a project owned by the synthetic team owner.

steps.title: Inspect empty project
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The synthetic project exists and no item edits have committed.

expectations.description: Viewer snapshot returns HTTP 200, head sequence zero and no items.

steps.title: Reject manifest count mismatch
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The project is empty and the member has write access.

expectations.description: A part-count mismatch returns HTTP 400 with invalid_batch.

mappings.why: The mismatched total is rejected with invalid_batch before staging.
The prepare route parses the submitted manifest, whose mismatched count is rejected.

steps.title: Prepare immutable two-part edit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The project is empty; a valid two-part manifest names a scene, character and direction.

expectations.description: The valid manifest returns HTTP 200, staged true and the same command ID.

mappings.why: The accepted two-part manifest is parsed with its identifiers, operation count and part descriptors; success does not test invalid bounds.
The valid manifest preserves the expected timing version for the staged edit.
The successful batches request is dispatched to the room batch handler.
A new manifest is checked against staged batches before its successful prepare.
A new prepare enters the branch that reserves the submitted part bytes.
The manifest is stored for the staged response.
The prepare returns the asserted staged command ID.

steps.title: Retry identical prepare
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The identical manifest is already staged by the same member session.

expectations.description: An identical prepare retry returns HTTP 200 and staged true.

mappings.why: An identical staged command passes the immutable request-hash check and returns staged.

steps.title: Reject changed manifest reuse
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest is staged under this command ID.

expectations.description: Changing the label under the staged command ID returns HTTP 409 command_reused.

mappings.why: Changing the label while reusing the staged command triggers command_reused.

steps.title: Reject commit before upload
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest is staged; neither upload part exists.

expectations.description: Commit before uploading any part returns HTTP 409 batch_incomplete.

mappings.why: A staged edit with no parts fails the required ordered-parts check.

steps.title: Reject mismatched part bytes
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest is staged with its immutable first-part digest.

expectations.description: Part bytes differing from the manifest return HTTP 400 batch_part_mismatch.

mappings.why: The room reads and hashes the provided part bytes before comparing the manifest.
The mismatched part bytes produce the asserted batch_part_mismatch response.

steps.title: Upload scene and character part
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest is staged; its first part contains scene and character.

expectations.description: The scene and character part returns HTTP 200, staged true and part index zero.

mappings.why: The accepted first part resolves the staged manifest and its expected descriptor.
The first part parses as the declared operation array and passes command validation before staging.
The accepted first part is stored and returns its asserted part index and staged flag.
The accepted part validates the scene identity, title and order; rejection boundaries are not exercised.
The accepted character is validated as a character with a name and portrait input.
The accepted character has a nonblank name and valid aliases and descriptive fields.

steps.title: Retry identical first part
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first part was uploaded with identical bytes by the same member.

expectations.description: An identical upload retry returns HTTP 200 and part index zero.

mappings.why: The identical first-part retry returns the same part index without replacing different content.

steps.title: Reject commit with missing second part
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
Only the first of two declared parts is uploaded.

expectations.description: Commit with the second part missing returns HTTP 409 batch_incomplete.

mappings.why: A two-part edit with only its first part fails the same completeness check.

steps.title: Verify no partial project state
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first part is uploaded but no structural edit has committed.

expectations.description: The viewer still sees head sequence zero and no items before commit.

steps.title: Reject viewer part upload
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest remains staged and the viewer lacks write access.

expectations.description: A viewer upload returns HTTP 403 read_only.

mappings.why: The viewer part upload is rejected as read_only before staging a part.

steps.title: Upload direction part
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first part is staged; the second contains the valid direction.

expectations.description: The direction part returns HTTP 200, staged true and part index one.

mappings.why: The accepted direction has valid scene ID, order, kind, text and timing fields.
The accepted direction has no spoken words and coverage reaches its owned duration.

steps.title: Commit complete atomic edit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
Both immutable parts are uploaded for the same member and project epoch.

expectations.description: The full commit returns sequence one, timing version one and snapshotRequired true.

mappings.why: Complete ordered parts are assembled into one validated command before the successful commit.
The assembled batch commits through the room transaction.
The successful batch returns the asserted receipt.
The successful batch commit uses the room storage transaction for its item changes.
Adding a direction changes timing and produces the asserted first timing version; other timing branches are not claimed.

steps.title: Inspect committed structural edit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first atomic edit has committed at sequence one.

expectations.description: Viewer snapshot has sequence one, timing version one, exactly scene, character and entry items, with the entry linked to the scene.

mappings.why: The committed put operations create versioned items returned by the subsequent snapshot.
The assembled changes pass cross-item reference validation before becoming visible together.

steps.title: Retry successful commit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original manifest has committed successfully and its receipt is retained.

expectations.description: The identical commit retry returns the exact original receipt.

mappings.why: The identical committed batch returns its stored receipt for the same user and manifest hash.
The identical retry returns the previously stored batch receipt.

steps.title: Reject changed successful retry
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The original command has committed; the retry changes its label.

expectations.description: A successful command ID reused with a changed label returns HTTP 409 command_reused.

mappings.why: The changed committed manifest produces command_reused rather than the saved receipt.

steps.title: Prepare image and anchored cue edit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first edit is committed at timing version one; the referenced scene, entry and character exist.

expectations.description: The image and anchored cue manifest returns HTTP 200 and staged true.

steps.title: Upload image and scene update
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The image and cue manifest is staged; the scene update expects version one.

expectations.description: The scene update and image part returns HTTP 200 with part index zero.

mappings.why: The accepted image has a valid synthetic filename, digest, media metadata and character tag; negative cases are not asserted.

steps.title: Upload anchored cue
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The image and cue manifest is staged; the cue refers to the existing entry and newly staged image.

expectations.description: The anchored cue part returns HTTP 200 with part index one.

mappings.why: The accepted cue supplies an anchor and duration and valid scene, timing, label and image fields.

steps.title: Commit image and cue edit
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
Both image and cue parts are uploaded at expected timing version one.

expectations.description: The second commit returns sequence two, timing version two and snapshotRequired true.

steps.title: Inspect image cue and scene update
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The second atomic edit has committed at sequence two.

expectations.description: Snapshot contains five items at sequence and timing version two, the version-two renamed scene, an image tagged to the character and a cue anchored to the entry and linked to the image.

steps.title: Prepare invalid direction variant
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The first two edits are committed; the variant declares a direction with a word timing.

expectations.description: The invalid direction variant manifest can be staged.

steps.title: Reject direction with spoken words
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The invalid direction manifest is staged with a digest matching the variant bytes.

expectations.description: A direction containing word timings returns HTTP 400 direction_timing during part upload.

mappings.why: A direction carrying a word is rejected with direction_timing.

steps.title: Prepare edit with missing reference
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The project has the five-item baseline; the orphan-edit manifest uses timing version two.

expectations.description: The missing-reference edit manifest returns HTTP 200 and staged true.

steps.title: Upload individually valid operations
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The rollback manifest is staged and its two operations are individually valid.

expectations.description: The individually valid scene and orphan entry part returns HTTP 200 and staged true.

steps.title: Reject commit with missing scene reference
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The rollback part was uploaded; its new entry refers to an absent scene.

expectations.description: The uploaded orphan entry causes HTTP 400 invalid_reference at commit.

mappings.why: An unavailable referenced item raises invalid_reference during the commit reference check.
The orphan entry checks its scene reference and produces the asserted invalid_reference response.
The failed commit leaves the transaction through its error path.
The failed reference check propagates out of the commit handler.

steps.title: Verify item snapshot rollback
preconditions: Isolated synthetic team, member and viewer sessions; real local Worker and project room.
The missing-reference commit was rejected and the prior five-item snapshot is retained for comparison.

expectations.description: The snapshot after rejected commit has the exact prior item array, head sequence and timing version.

mappings.why: The later identical snapshot witnesses rollback of the failed batch transaction, including the scene put before the orphan entry.

scenarios.title: Atomic multi-part structural edit and rollback
